environment.description: Service deployed as an AWS Lambda function with a Function URL configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The Lambda function URL resource policy specifies a principal condition (aws:PrincipalOrgID) restricting invocation to identities within the organization. Callers without valid SigV4 signatures receive HTTP 403 from the Lambda service before the function executes. The Kafka consumer runs as a separate Lambda triggered by MSK event source mapping (no HTTP exposure). Note: the Function URL does NOT use CORS allow-origin *, and the resource policy does not include a wildcard principal. The session fixation endpoint /session/init is only reachable through the authenticated Function URL path.

config.kafka_consumer: Separate Lambda with MSK event source mapping, no HTTP trigger
config.network: No public ALB, Function URL is the only HTTP ingress
